description: Describes MXL transport parameters. The constraints in this schema are minimum constraints, but may be further constrained at the constraints endpoint. Receivers MUST support at least the `mxl_domain_id` and `mxl_flow_id` parameters.
title: MXL Receiver Transport Parameters

mxl_domain_id.description: Specifies the MXL domain id where the MXL flow will be located. A null value indicates that the domain ID has not been configured.

mxl_flow_id.description: Specifies the MXL flow id which will be used for read operation. A null value indicates that the flow ID has not been configured.
